source_summary: Vertical monochrome Chinese winter landscape with layered snow-covered mountains, misty wash, leafless tree groves, clustered pavilions, winding paths, riverside houses, and broad water surfaces. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded as motifs.

motifs.name: upper_left_snow_arch_peaks
motifs.description: Large sweeping snow-covered mountain mass on the upper left, with two arched ridge bands, dark ink contour strokes, soft dry-brush shading along the slopes, dotted texture at ridge crests, and sparse leafless trees tucked into the left and lower ravines.
must_preserve: dry-brush shadow washes along inner slopes
small dotted rock texture near ridge tops
bare twig-like tree strokes in ravines

motifs.name: central_distant_peak_chain
motifs.description: Narrow chain of distant rounded snow peaks in the upper middle valley, partly veiled by mist, with small clustered bare trees and dark shrub strokes at the bases.
must_preserve: thin ink outlines on each peak
tiny bare tree clusters between peaks

motifs.name: upper_right_twin_snow_peaks
motifs.description: Pair of tall pale snow peaks rising at the upper right edge, connected by a dark shaded valley saddle and sparse ink texture along the lower slopes.
must_preserve: minimal but distinct rock texture at bases

motifs.name: mid_temple_pavilion_cluster
motifs.description: Cluster of multi-tiered temple or pavilion roofs nestled among middle-height hills and leafless trees, including layered eaves, small wall lines, surrounding rounded snow mounds, and dense twig brushwork.
must_preserve: stacked roof geometry with upturned eaves
small dark window and wall marks
surrounding bare tree trunks and branches

motifs.name: central_winding_mountain_path
motifs.description: Light winding mountain path descending through the central-right hills from the temple area toward the lower water, bordered by dark ink banks, shrubs, and snow-covered rounded slopes.
must_preserve: dark contour strokes along path banks
small shrub dots and dry-brush shadows

motifs.name: lower_left_gate_and_winter_grove
motifs.description: Lower-left hillside grove with tall leafless trees, dark vertical trunks, fine branching, rounded snow rocks, and a small gate-like pavilion set into the slope above the water; excludes nearby calligraphy.
must_preserve: small pavilion/gate roof and wall lines
dark base washes at roots and rocks

motifs.name: lower_riverside_house_cluster
motifs.description: Riverside houses and fenced compound in the lower right-middle, with long low thatched or tiled roofs, rectangular walls, small windows, a brush fence, and adjacent rocky bank.
must_preserve: fence strokes in front of buildings
irregular rock ledges along water edge

motifs.name: lower_right_broad_water_and_shores
motifs.description: Broad calm water surface occupying the lower right, framed by pale rocky banks and stepped shoreline ledges, with soft gray wash suggesting depth and misty reflection.
must_preserve: stepped ledge shapes near the village
soft tonal gradient without added objects

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
